name: Oliver G Brewer Iii
current_role: President and CEO, Callaway Golf Company (NYSE: CALY; formerly Topgolf Callaway Brands)
profile: Oliver 'Chip' Brewer III has led Callaway since March 2012 after 14 years at Adams Golf (joined 1998 as SVP sales & marketing, CEO 2002-2012). He oversaw the Topgolf merger and, after selling Jack Wolfskin and 60% of Topgolf, returned the company to a pure-play golf focus and its Callaway Golf Company name in 2026. William & Mary economics grad, Harvard MBA.
interesting_fact: In 2025-26 he reversed the Topgolf megamerger he championed: Callaway sold a 60% stake in Topgolf and Jack Wolfskin, renamed itself Callaway Golf Company and now trades as CALY.
deep_cut_fact: His father, O. Gordon Brewer Jr., found golf at a mom-and-pop driving range while on a basketball scholarship at Guilford College, went on to win the U.S. Senior Amateur twice, was Pine Valley's president for about a decade and won the USGA's Bob Jones Award (2009); GOLF.com says he once called a penalty on Chip at a Pine Valley event.
notes: Goes by 'Chip'. Company is based in Carlsbad, CA. Best route is via Callaway IR/communications; he rarely does non-golf media.
